purpose: Screen camera-photo and post-processing control sources before any new detector or fusion candidate is selected.

sources.name: RAISE
sources.observed_scope: 8156 high-resolution camera-native RAW images from three cameras, with scene/category metadata; full download about 350 GB and named subsets/custom selection are available.
sources.license_observation: Official download and guide pages restrict use to non-commercial research and educational purposes and require citation.
constraints: Do not download the 350 GB full archive.
Preserve the official metadata and source RAW hash.
Three cameras are insufficient as the only real-control source.

sources.name: MIT-Adobe FiveK
sources.observed_scope: 5000 SLR photographs in DNG with semantic scene/light metadata and five expert TIFF renditions; the full archive is about 50 GB and individual files are available.
sources.license_observation: The Adobe-MIT research license permits use, copying, modification and distribution solely for research without commercial advantage, with copyright and license retention; it applies only to the listed files.
constraints: Select only filenames present in the matching official license list.
Store the applicable license alongside the manifest.
Treat RAW development and expert TIFF renditions as transforms of one source cluster, never independent controls.
Do not download the 50 GB full archive.

sources.name: HDR+ Burst Photography Dataset
sources.observed_scope: 3640 mobile-camera bursts with raw DNG frames; the official curated subset contains 153 bursts and is about 37 GiB, with anonymous per-object download from the public Google Cloud bucket.
sources.license_observation: The official page links CC BY-SA 4.0 and requests citation and good-taste use because some subjects are the authors' friends and family.
constraints: Do not download the 37 GiB curated subset or 765 GiB full collection.
Treat every frame and rendered result from one burst as one source cluster.
Freeze one payload_N000.dng object per selected burst before detector scoring.

Catalog only Google Cloud object metadata plus bounded classic-TIFF header and IFD ranges; accept complete or partial DNG identity only when present tags map uniquely and consistently to one registered official device, and record all-three-absent identity without guessing a device.
Retain attribution, license link, transformation notice and ShareAlike terms for distributed adaptations.
The 2014-2016 Nexus and first-generation Pixel devices are not a current-phone population sample.

sources.name: Forchheim Image Database
sources.observed_scope: More than 23000 JPEG images: 143 scenes captured by 27 smartphone cameras, each with one camera-native image and five social-network copies.
sources.license_observation: No explicit image-use license was visible on the accessible official project description or paper during this screen.
constraints: Public downloadability is not treated as a reuse license.
Do not substitute an unverified third-party repack.

sources.name: DPED
sources.observed_scope: More than 22000 synchronously captured photos from three smartphones and one Canon 70D; a 125 MB sample and a 54 GB original-photo archive are linked.
sources.license_observation: The accessible official project page and repository describe downloads and citation but do not state a dataset image license.
constraints: A source-code license, if later found, must not be assumed to license the photographs.
Do not download the 54 GB archive for a source screen.

sources.name: Dresden Image Database
sources.observed_scope: The paper describes original JPEGs from multiple camera devices/models and scientific availability; the historical official download endpoint was not available in this screen.
sources.license_observation: A third-party repack presents conflicting CC0 and restrictive copyright text, so it is not accepted as authoritative.
constraints: Do not inherit a third-party hosting label when it conflicts with embedded terms.

source_clusters: 40 MIT-Adobe FiveK AdobeMIT-licensed DNG sources across camera/scene/light strata
40 RAISE camera-native RAW sources across all three cameras and seven scene tags
40 HDR+ curated mobile-camera bursts, one payload_N000.dng per burst, under CC BY-SA 4.0
required_variants_per_source: deterministic sRGB development or camera-native JPEG
one documented social-platform copy when an official paired source permits it
recommended_next_cohort.split_rule: All variants of one source remain in one split; camera device, scene, and near-duplicate clusters must not cross calibration and final evaluation.
recommended_next_cohort.selection_rule: Freeze filenames and source hashes before reading detector scores.
recommended_next_cohort.stopping_rule: Do not train or retune a fusion rule until at least three independent real-source families and the transform variants are present.

limitations: This is a source and license screen, not legal advice.
One official 6.36 MB HDR+ DNG was downloaded for the initial feasibility probe. Catalog work then read only bounded TIFF header/IFD ranges before the deterministic forty-burst selection was frozen.

HDR+ catalog protocols v1-v4 preserve score-blind failures for fixed-prefix IFD placement, consumer-name aliases, all-absent identity tags and uniquely mappable partial identity tags; v5 closed all 153 bursts as 123 registered, 18 registered-partial and 12 identity-unavailable records.

The score-blind selector froze 40 bursts totalling 765,999,090 source bytes, and the separately registered source-preparation protocol binds the acquisition, catalog and selection hashes before complete DNG access; none of these stages authorizes runtime changes.

All forty HDR+ DNGs and metadata-free JPEG-95 views were subsequently hash-verified. The frozen five-channel audit found 2/40 original-view and 1/40 JPEG-85 product-OR hits, with no stable cross-view hit; the report forbids threshold or runtime changes.
Availability and terms must be rechecked at acquisition time.
